comment: Scene lengths in beats (120 BPM: 1 beat = 15 frames = 0.5 s). The lineup is one continuous set cut into scenes, so every cut is hard; the phone rises inside `check`, and BRAVO lands at its beat 11.6. `outro` is the tease cut's (the father's last line, 60 beats = 30 s); timeline.ts takes 3 beats off it for the plain cut. scripts/verite-03/make-music.mjs reads this file, so the music follows any retiming.
